summary: Completed testing of 3 new features: Gate Presets, KB Export/Import, and KB Share. All 15 backend tests passed (1 skipped as expected). All frontend features verified working correctly.

issues: Open preset (85%) shows 'Fully Open' label instead of 'Mostly Open' - this is correct per code logic (81-100% = Fully Open) but may not match user expectation from the preset name 'Open'

critical_code_review_comments: KB Export correctly strips instance_id for portability and includes version, count, exported_at, source_instance_id fields
KB Import uses soft-delete (deactivates old sources with archived_at timestamp) when overwrite=true - good for data recovery
KB Share correctly validates target instance exists and prevents sharing to same instance
Gate presets (Conservative 10%, Balanced 50%, Open 85%) correctly update both knowledge_gate_pct and legacy knowledge_gate field
Preset button highlighting works via border color change when selected
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed sources during import tests, cleaned up after
context_for_next_testing_agent: Three new features tested: 1) Gate Presets - Conservative (10%), Balanced (50%), Open (85%) quick-pick buttons on Bot Settings Knowledge Gate card. 2) KB Export - GET /api/knowledge/export returns JSON with version, count, sources array; triggers file download. 3) KB Import - POST /api/knowledge/import accepts sources array with optional overwrite flag. 4) KB Share - POST /api/knowledge/share copies sources to target instance (currently only 1 instance exists so share shows 'No other instances' toast - expected behavior). All features working correctly.
